en.abdullah-al-shahin: (5) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from Muhammad bin Ahmad al-Qalanisi from Muhammad bin Ali from Abu Jameela from Abu Bakr al-Hadhrami that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “We (the prophet’s progeny)
do not time this matter (the appearance of al-Qa’im).”
